title: Singleton
desc: Provide one shared instance through a controlled access point.
problem: Independent callers create separate database connections.
solution: Hide construction; return the same instance to every caller.
before:
a = new Database()
b = new Database()
a.query(sql)
// a and b are different objects
after:
a = Database.getInstance()
b = Database.getInstance()
a.query(sql)
assert a is b

title: Factory Method
desc: Let creator subclasses choose the product used by shared business logic.
problem: Logistics directly constructs trucks; sea delivery forces edits.
solution: Override a creation method while preserving delivery planning.
reuse: Factory Pattern Infographic_ Before and After (1).png

title: Abstract Factory
desc: Create related products through a family-specific factory.
problem: Direct construction can mix modern chairs with Victorian sofas.
solution: Select one family factory; request products through interfaces.
after:
factory = new ModernFactory()
chair = factory.createChair()
sofa = factory.createSofa()

title: Builder
desc: Separate construction steps from the representation being assembled.
problem: Long car constructors and separate manual assembly duplicate choices.
solution: A director runs the same recipe against different builders.
after:
builder = new CarBuilder()
director.sportsCar(builder)
car = builder.getResult()
// use ManualBuilder for a matching manual

title: Adapter
case: XML stock data and JSON analytics
desc: Translate an existing interface into the interface a client expects.
problem: The stock app supplies XML; the analytics library requires JSON.
solution: An adapter accepts XML, converts it, then delegates analytics.
before:
xml = provider.getStockData()
library = new JsonAnalyticsLibrary()
report = library.analyze(xml)
// incompatible input format
after:
service = new XmlAnalyticsAdapter(library)
xml = provider.getStockData()
report = service.analyze(xml)

title: Bridge
desc: Separate two independent dimensions so both can evolve independently.
problem: Each shape/color combination requires another subclass.
solution: Shapes hold a Color reference instead of encoding color in inheritance.
before:
redCircle = new RedCircle()
blueSquare = new BlueSquare()
redCircle.draw()
// more combinations, more classes
after:
shape = new Circle(new Red())
shape.draw()
shape.color = new Blue()
shape.draw()

title: Facade
desc: Expose a simple entry point to a complex subsystem.
problem: Every client coordinates codecs, bitrate conversion, and audio repair.
solution: A facade orchestrates the subsystem behind one conversion call.
before:
codec = CodecFactory.extract(file)
raw = BitrateReader.read(file, codec)
video = BitrateReader.convert(raw, mp4)
result = AudioMixer.fix(video)

title: Proxy
desc: Control access to a service through the same interface.
problem: Repeated video downloads invoke the remote service again.
solution: A proxy caches results and delegates only on a cache miss.
before:
service = new ThirdPartyVideoService()
a = service.downloadVideo(id)
b = service.downloadVideo(id)
// two remote requests
after:
service = new CachedVideoProxy(realService)
a = service.downloadVideo(id)
b = service.downloadVideo(id)
// second request uses the cache
snodes:
- real: VideoService
- cache: Map
+ downloadVideo(id): Video

title: Composite
desc: Treat individual objects and recursive groups through one interface.
problem: Pricing code distinguishes products from nested boxes repeatedly.
solution: A box sums child prices; each child follows the same contract.

title: Template Method
desc: Fix an algorithm’s order while subclasses implement selected steps.
problem: Format-specific miners duplicate the processing and reporting pipeline.
solution: Move the sequence into a base method; override extraction only.

title: Strategy
desc: Make alternative algorithms interchangeable through a shared contract.
problem: A navigator grows conditionals for road, walking, and transit routes.
solution: Delegate routing to a strategy selected by the client.
snodes:
- strategy: RouteStrategy
+ setStrategy(s)
+ buildRoute(a, b): Route

title: State
desc: Delegate behavior to an object representing the current state.
problem: Publication rules accumulate in a switch over document status.
solution: Each state handles publish and can transition the document.
after:
doc = new Document(new Draft())
doc.publish(user)  // enters moderation
doc.publish(admin) // becomes published

title: Observer
case: Editor events notify logging and email
desc: Notify registered subscribers when a publisher emits an event.
problem: Editor logic directly invokes concrete logging and email services.
solution: Publish an event; subscribers handle their own reactions.
before:
editor.saveFile()
logger.write(file.name)
mailer.send(file.name)
// client must wire every reaction
after:
events.subscribe("save", new LogListener())
events.subscribe("save", new EmailListener())
editor.saveFile() // emits save event
snodes:
- listeners: EventListener[0..*]
+ subscribe(type, listener)
+ unsubscribe(type, listener)
+ notify(type, data)

title: Command
desc: Represent a request as an object that can be invoked and undone.
problem: Buttons and shortcuts duplicate editing actions without shared undo.
solution: Bind both triggers to a command; store successful edits in history.
after:
paste = new PasteCommand(editor, text)
pasteButton.bind(() => app.execute(paste))
shortcut.bind(() => app.execute(paste))
app.undo()
snodes:
- editor: Editor
- backup: String
+ execute(): Boolean
+ undo()
